components.name: Primary Workspace Button
components.description: The 48px mineral-teal action used to start the extraction-first workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-width: 10.5rem; height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 16px; background: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); color: var(--primary-foreground, rgb(250 252 251)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 680; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Research Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action for reopening, filtering, inspecting, and review controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.13); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: rgb(var(--canvas-rgb, 242 246 245) / 0.66); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.55); background: rgb(var(--fog-rgb, 221 233 230) / 0.65); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Workspace Input
components.description: The large, exact field used inside the softly irregular workspace launcher.
components.css: .ds-workspace-field { display: grid; gap: 0.48rem; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-field > span { color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.78); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 620; } .ds-workspace-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.18); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 14px; background: rgb(var(--canvas-rgb, 242 246 245) / 0.7); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-workspace-input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.68); } .ds-workspace-input:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.55); } .ds-workspace-input:focus-visible { border-color: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.16); } .ds-workspace-input:invalid { border-color: rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 173 52 63)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 173 52 63) / 0.2); } .ds-workspace-input:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--input, rgb(168 187 182)) 50%, transparent); opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Workspace Tab Rail
components.description: The narrow desktop research rail that becomes a sticky horizontal scroller on compact screens.
components.html: Workspace
components.css: .ds-tab-rail { display: flex; width: 184px; min-height: 260px; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 20px 12px; background: rgb(var(--slide-rgb, 232 239 237) / 0.72); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-kicker { margin: 2px 11px 13px; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.68); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tab-item { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.62); font: inherit; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 580; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-tab-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tab-item:hover { background: rgb(var(--fog-rgb, 221 233 230) / 0.58); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); } .ds-tab-item[aria-selected="true"] { background: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.13); color: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); } .ds-tab-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-tab-rail { width: 100%; min-height: auto; flex-direction: row; overflow-x: auto; padding: 10px; } .ds-tab-kicker { display: none; } .ds-tab-item { width: auto; min-width: max-content; } }

components.name: Inspectable Source Card
components.description: A flat, rule-led source container that keeps record type, title, and supporting text inspectable.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-source-card { display: grid; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.12); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; background: rgb(var(--canvas-rgb, 242 246 245) / 0.62); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-source-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 650; } .ds-source-card p { margin: 0; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.7); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-source-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-source-chip { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; background: rgb(var(--slide-rgb, 232 239 237)); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.74); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 620; } .ds-source-card:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.55); background: rgb(var(--fog-rgb, 221 233 230) / 0.34); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-source-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-evidence-ribbon { position: relative; display: grid; width: min(100%, 620px); gap: 5px; padding-bottom: 25px; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.68); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ribbon-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(80px, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 13px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 610; line-height: 1; } .ds-ribbon-row i { display: block; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.26), rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.9)); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-source-arrival 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--ds-index) * 90ms + 100ms); } .ds-ribbon-spine { position: absolute; right: -4%; bottom: 4px; width: 65%; height: 13px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); transform: rotate(7deg); transform-origin: right; animation: ds-source-arrival 900ms 380ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-source-arrival { from { opacity: 0.25; transform: scaleX(0.08); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); } } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-ribbon-row { grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr; font-size: 0.61rem; } .ds-ribbon-spine { width: 72%; height: 9px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ribbon-row i, .ds-ribbon-spine { animation-duration: 0.01ms; opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-provenance-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 0.8fr) minmax(420px, 1.45fr); align-items: center; gap: 32px; min-height: 120px; border-radius: 18px; padding: 22px 28px; background: rgb(var(--paper-rgb, 250 252 251)); color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft, 0 24px 70px rgb(28 55 50 / 0.1)); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Helvetica Neue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-provenance-copy h2 { max-width: 22ch; margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.7rem); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.028em; font-weight: 690; } .ds-provenance-copy p { max-width: 34ch; margin: 9px 0 0; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.62); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.48; } .ds-provenance-counts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; } .ds-provenance-counts > div { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115) / 0.32); padding: 11px 12px 11px 16px; } .ds-provenance-counts span { overflow: hidden; color: rgb(var(--ink-rgb, 17 24 23) / 0.6); font-size: 0.67rem; font-weight: 590; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-provenance-counts strong { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 690; } .ds-provenance-summary:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--teal-rgb, 0 121 115)); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-provenance-summary { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; } } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-provenance-summary { padding: 18px; } .ds-provenance-counts { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
The Evidence Ribbon makes evidence provenance the composition. Cool mineral surfaces, graphite type, and one teal signal create a trustworthy, exact workspace that feels softly irregular rather than rigid; the visual world stays sober enough for biomedical review without becoming sterile.

Four source families visibly converge into inspectable extraction rows before synthesis. Large flowing fields carry the path through the product, while the controls inside them remain compact, precise, and immediately legible. Atmospheric or cinematic research dashboards and generic equal-weight card grids are explicit anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Provenance remains visible from source families to extraction.
One mineral teal signal organizes action, focus, and evidence flow.
Cool paper and fog layers support graphite data typography in both themes.
Softly irregular fields frame the entry sequence; controls remain exact and compact.
Tonal layering carries hierarchy; shadows are reserved for floating or focal surfaces.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mineral teal is the only non-semantic accent; reserve safety red for risk, error, and uncertainty that needs attention.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes preserve role, hierarchy, and contrast; dark mode is a semantic remap, not a decorative alternate palette.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Use League Gothic for large navigational or section landmarks only; keep evidence content in Geist so dense rows remain legible.

rules.name: The Visible Path Rule
rules.body: Keep the launcher, four source families, extraction shell, and cited inspection context in one continuous spatial story.

rules.name: The Ambient Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting panels rely on tone and 1px rules; apply ambient shadow only to floating, overlapping, or focal surfaces.

rules.name: The Flow-and-Precision Rule
rules.body: Soft irregularity belongs to large flow fields; controls and evidence containers use exact, modest radii.

rules.name: The Inspectable State Rule
rules.body: Every active, reviewed, risky, or selected state must pair color with visible text, structure, or iconography.

dos: Do keep provenance visible before any synthesis surface.
Do use mineral teal sparingly for action, focus, active state, and evidence flow.
Do use 14–18px radii for data surfaces and 10–12px radii for precise controls.
Do preserve semantic role and readable contrast across both light and dark themes.
Do retain the 3px visible focus treatment and reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't turn the interface into an atmospheric or cinematic research dashboard.
Don't arrange the workflow as a generic equal-weight card grid.
Don't use safety red as a general accent or encode risk through color alone.
Don't stack a border and a heavy shadow on every surface.
Don't introduce serif display type or additional decorative font families.
